provenance.store_verification: Exact method source segment equality after CRLF normalization; main read with git show <commit>:app.py. archive_daily is newly added but is not called by /api/random.

method.transport: Flask test_client POST /api/random; full dispatch and JSON serialization, no HTTP server or TCP
method.timing: perf_counter_ns; response parsing and SVG verification excluded; all samples retained; nearest-rank percentiles
method.pairing: Identical SHA256-sorted IDs selected from the real Store pool through a benchmark-only choice replacement; Store unchanged
method.cold: Fresh app/runtime per arm/round; distinct unseen artwork for each request; growing manifest; SQLite tables initialized before timing
method.hot: Full 2650-entry manifest generated outside timing in both current arms; SQLite detail cache empty, bundled local summaries; manifest unchanged asserted
method.sqlite: Production defaults, no WAL or timeout changes; uncontended sequential cold/hot; held BEGIN IMMEDIATE writer uses independent connection
method.held_writer: 250 ms after confirmed Store.pick entry; request must remain blocked until rollback; actual hold recorded
method.held_writer_long: One 5250 ms hold per arm in first round; diagnostic only, not a tail-probability estimate
method.concurrent: 4 requests and two distinct-ID ensure_artwork updates released by a barrier per batch; both updates write new SVGs and the shared manifest; main has request workers only
method.bypass: Same current app/publication merge/SQLite; artwork_fields returns {}; full cache and concurrent updater workload retained
method.isolation: Frozen source snapshots, subprocess per arm/round, TemporaryDirectory runtimes, background=False, socket and DNS denied
method.reproduction: Use the recorded baseline commit and matching current_sha256 source/data files; run the recorded command from the repository root. Results depend on host load; no pass/fail latency threshold is imposed.
limits: Cold means application/artwork cache miss, not cold OS page cache or process startup latency
Benchmark choice scans for a fixed ID instead of production secrets.choice; this small selection overhead is present in every arm
No browser image transfer/render, remote detail refresh, fsync durability change, or deployment latency measured
Threaded contention in this benchmark; cross-process correctness belongs to the concurrency regression tests
Shared Windows host load and antivirus can affect tails; rotated sequential arms are paired inputs, not simultaneous or causal proof
Manifest updates target distinct IDs from measured draws; same-ID version races are covered separately by concurrency tests
Artificial held-writer delays demonstrate an imposed blocker; they do not establish the cause or frequency of a previous slow request

interpretation.store: Every existing main Store method is source-identical, including pick/connect/cached_details. The class has gained archive_daily, which /api/random does not call. Shared transaction and busy-wait costs cannot be attributed to a new random-draw Store algorithm.
interpretation.artwork: current minus current_artwork_bypass estimates incremental request artwork work with other current app behavior retained; measured artwork_fields spans provide supporting attribution.
interpretation.baseline: current minus main includes artwork plus publication/payload changes; it is not an artwork-only comparison. Concurrent main lacks artwork writers, so bypass is the better contention control.
interpretation.lock: A deliberately held SQLite writer can dominate both versions before artwork runs; compare store_pick spans and confirmed_hold_ms rather than assuming image generation caused the entire delay.
